title: A restore block can name the directory its program starts in
body:
A restore block (`decade_channel::Restore { argv, terminal }`) starts its program in the workspace's directory. Before e3f2cf7, decade restarted a coax session in the directory coax ran in. A coax started in a subdirectory now comes back in the workspace's directory, and an agent that finds its session by project directory may not find it there.

## Proposal

- `Restore` gains an optional `cwd`. decade starts the argv there, and in the workspace's directory when `cwd` is absent or no longer exists.
- When the save file reader turns an old saved coax session into a restore block, it carries the session's directory into `cwd`.
- coax sends its directory in the block, in coax-5c168a.

## Cost

An optional field on the `restore` block in `docs/protocol.md`, and on `Restore`, which is public in `decade-channel`. Both are unreleased since `Restore` arrived in abb5631. The save format stays at 9, since 9 is unreleased and the new field is optional.
